//atlassian-slack: The org authorised the Atlassian (Jira) and Slack MCP servers for native Claude Code ONLY, not for other harnesses. omp translates Claude Code's MCP config (~/.claude.json, ~/.claude/mcp.json, project .claude/.mcp.json) and would otherwise connect to them the moment they are added there. `disabledServers` is the highest-precedence denylist and hides a server by name from EVERY source, so these two entries keep omp out regardless of what Claude Code holds. Names must match what Claude Code registers (`claude mcp add atlassian ...` -> `atlassian`); after adding them there, run `/mcp list` in omp and confirm neither appears — a namespaced plugin name such as `atlassian:atlassian` would need its own entry.
